segments.text: Hello and welcome to this massive open online course, Introduction to BioRisk Management.
segments.zh: 大家好，欢迎学习这门大规模开放在线课程“生物风险管理导论”。

segments.text: I am your instructor Kenneth, and in this segment we will be discussing about samples
segments.zh: 我是你们的讲师 Kenneth，在这一部分，我们将讨论样本，

segments.text: and specifically referring to hospital derived samples.
segments.zh: 特别是来自医院的样本。

segments.text: Now in your role as a laboratory technician in a biosafety level 3 laboratory, you will
segments.zh: 作为生物安全三级实验室的实验室技术人员，你

segments.text: be required to analyze samples from different locations.
segments.zh: 需要分析来自不同地方的样本。

segments.text: Samples which are derived from researchers which consist of exonic opeocultures are easy
segments.zh: 来自研究人员的样本，由纯培养物组成，比较容易

segments.text: to analyze because the risk can be assessed very easily.
segments.zh: 分析，因为风险很容易评估。

segments.text: We are aware of the biological agent and we are also aware of any modifications which have
segments.zh: 我们清楚是哪种生物因子，也清楚对该生物因子

segments.text: been made to that biological agent.
segments.zh: 做过的任何改造。

segments.text: The situation changes slightly when we have to analyze samples derived from patients.
segments.zh: 而当我们必须分析来自患者的样本时，情况就有些不同了。

segments.text: These may be in the form of swabs, serum samples, blood, urine or stools.
segments.zh: 这些样本可能是拭子、血清样本、血液、尿液或粪便。

segments.text: When samples are received from hospitals, they may consist of more than one biological agent
segments.zh: 从医院收到的样本中，一份样本里

segments.text: within a single sample.
segments.zh: 可能含有不止一种生物因子。

segments.text: How do we address this risk?
segments.zh: 我们该如何应对这种风险？

segments.text: In the case of hospital samples, we assume the highest possible risk.
segments.zh: 对于医院样本，我们按照可能的最高风险来对待。

segments.text: When samples are received from hospitals, they will be shipped in a special packing container.
segments.zh: 从医院收到的样本会装在专门的包装容器中运送。

segments.text: This is an example of a bag in which the sample will be shipped.
segments.zh: 这是一个用来运送样本的袋子的例子。

segments.text: This bag will be sealed, it will be locked with a tie and then shipped in a container
segments.zh: 这个袋子会被密封，用扎带锁紧，然后装进一个容器中运送，

segments.text: which may contain ice or some other refrigerant such as carbon dioxide, CO2 ice, what we call
segments.zh: 容器里可能装有冰或其他制冷剂，比如二氧化碳、CO2 冰，也就是我们所说的

segments.text: as the dry ice.
segments.zh: 干冰。

segments.text: When you receive these samples, the first thing which we need to do is to ensure that
segments.zh: 收到这些样本时，我们首先要做的，是确保

segments.text: the outer packing material is thoroughly sterilized with a sterilant.
segments.zh: 用灭菌剂对外包装材料进行彻底消毒。

segments.text: In our case, we use 70% ethanol, we wait for around 30 seconds and we open the bag after
segments.zh: 我们这里使用 70% 乙醇，等待大约 30 秒，30 秒后

segments.text: 30 seconds.
segments.zh: 再打开袋子。

segments.text: The 30 second period is known as the contact time.
segments.zh: 这 30 秒被称为接触时间。

segments.text: Once you have opened your bag, you will obtain the sample.
segments.zh: 打开袋子后，就可以取出样本。

segments.text: I am going to take out a sample from this bag.
segments.zh: 我现在要从这个袋子里取出一份样本。

segments.text: The sample will be generally shipped in a tube like this.
segments.zh: 样本一般会装在这样的管子里运送。

segments.text: This is a sample containing tube.
segments.zh: 这是一支装有样本的管子。

segments.text: I cannot reveal the details of the patient as this is a patient derived sample.
segments.zh: 由于这是来自患者的样本，我不能透露患者的详细信息。

segments.text: This sample is basically a serum sample you can see in the tube.
segments.zh: 这份样本基本上是血清样本，大家可以在管中看到。

segments.text: You can note that there is a small ward of bandage over here.
segments.zh: 大家可以注意到，这里有一小团纱布。

segments.text: There is a purpose for this specific ward of bandage here.
segments.zh: 这一小团纱布是有专门用途的。

segments.text: When I open the sample in the biological safety cabinet, any of the serum which drips from
segments.zh: 当我在生物安全柜中打开样本时，从这支管子里滴出的任何血清

segments.text: this particular tube will be trapped by this ward.
segments.zh: 都会被这团纱布吸住。

segments.text: It will not spill onto my gloves and cause a breach of containment.
segments.zh: 血清就不会洒到我的手套上，造成防护失效。

segments.text: This is one of the key aspects of transporting samples from hospitals.
segments.zh: 这是从医院运送样本的关键要点之一。

segments.text: They must be accompanied with the proper transport security.
segments.zh: 样本运送必须有适当的运输安保措施。

segments.text: The technician who has drawn the sample or the doctor at the hospital has to ensure that
segments.zh: 采集样本的技术人员或医院的医生必须确保

segments.text: the sample is properly labeled and properly bagged so as to ensure that the transport
segments.zh: 样本标签正确、装袋妥当，以确保运输

segments.text: agent or the one who transport the sample to the hospital as well as the technician
segments.zh: 人员，或者说负责运送样本到医院的人，以及

segments.text: who works in the laboratory is basically protected from the biological agent.
segments.zh: 在实验室工作的技术人员，基本上都能免受生物因子的伤害。

segments.text: What happens when these samples come into our lab?
segments.zh: 这些样本进入我们的实验室后会怎样处理？

segments.text: Basically there are two types of samples which come in.
segments.zh: 基本上，进来的样本有两种类型。

segments.text: The first in which we have to culture the biological agent.
segments.zh: 第一种是需要培养生物因子的样本。

segments.text: In this case, we practice the extreme set of precautions and we assess the risk in terms
segments.zh: 在这种情况下，我们采取最严格的预防措施，并按照

segments.text: of a live culture.
segments.zh: 活培养物来评估风险。

segments.text: So, the sample, for instance, bacterial samples may need to be transferred onto media.
segments.zh: 例如，细菌样本可能需要转接到培养基上。

segments.text: In the case of serum samples which are to be analyzed for instance, nucleic acids
segments.zh: 而对于要分析的血清样本，比如分析核酸，

segments.text: or in this case, we are analyzing samples from COVID-19 patients or suspected patients.
segments.zh: 或者像我们这里，分析来自 COVID-19 患者或疑似患者的样本，

segments.text: We move on to the next step which is inactivation of the sample.
segments.zh: 我们就进入下一步，也就是样本灭活。

segments.text: Now, for inactivation of the samples, we have to follow the standard operating procedure
segments.zh: 对样本进行灭活时，我们必须遵循

segments.text: for that particular biological agent.
segments.zh: 针对该特定生物因子的标准操作规程。

segments.text: In this case of COVID-19, it involves elevating the sample to a temperature of 60 to 70 degrees
segments.zh: 对于 COVID-19，就是在加热模块中把样本加热到 60 到 70 度，

segments.text: in a thermal block and after a period of one hour, the sample is basically inactivated.
segments.zh: 一小时后，样本基本上就被灭活了。

segments.text: Now, remember that all these procedures must be conducted within a biological safety cabinet
segments.zh: 请记住，所有这些操作都必须在生物安全柜中进行，

segments.text: with the appropriate PPEs and in accordance with the administrative procedures
segments.zh: 穿戴适当的个人防护装备，并遵守管理程序

segments.text: or administrative controls.
segments.zh: 或者说管理控制措施。

segments.text: Once the sample is inactivated, we can process to the next step which is the extraction
segments.zh: 样本灭活后，就可以进行下一步，也就是核酸

segments.text: of the nucleic acid which must also be conducted in a biological safety cabinet.
segments.zh: 提取，这一步同样必须在生物安全柜中进行。

segments.text: Once the nucleic acid is extracted, the sample is ready for processing which in terms of the analysis.
segments.zh: 核酸提取完成后，样本就可以进行处理，也就是进行分析。

segments.text: So, in our case for COVID-19, we use a thermal cycler, a real-time thermal cycler
segments.zh: 在我们这里，针对 COVID-19，我们使用热循环仪，也就是实时荧光定量热循环仪，

segments.text: which will analyze the sample for the specific biological agent.
segments.zh: 它会针对特定的生物因子对样本进行分析。

segments.text: Now, all these aspects need to be integrated into your sample preparation strategy.
segments.zh: 所有这些方面都需要整合到你的样本制备策略中。

segments.text: You must assess the risk of the procedure itself.
segments.zh: 你必须评估操作程序本身的风险。

segments.text: So, coming back to what we have learned, we have a risk assessment.
segments.zh: 回到我们学过的内容，首先是风险评估。

segments.text: So, we assess the risk caused by the biological agent.
segments.zh: 我们评估生物因子带来的风险。

segments.text: In the case of a sample from hospital patients, we assume the highest risk.
segments.zh: 对于来自医院患者的样本，我们按照最高风险来对待。

segments.text: We then apply the specific controls.
segments.zh: 然后我们实施具体的控制措施。

segments.text: So, in this case, I'm in a biological safety level 3 laboratory
segments.zh: 在这里，我身处生物安全三级实验室，

segments.text: and I'm applying the pertinent engineering controls as well
segments.zh: 正在实施相应的工程控制措施，

segments.text: as the personal protective equipment which I'm wearing and the engineering controls
segments.zh: 还有我所穿戴的个人防护装备，而工程控制

segments.text: which is this unit itself.
segments.zh: 就是这个设施本身。

segments.text: These are some of the key points which we need to take into consideration
segments.zh: 这些是在管理来自已知和未知样本的生物因子时

segments.text: when managing biological agents where from known as well as unknown samples.
segments.zh: 需要考虑的一些关键要点。

segments.text: Thank you very much for watching this short segment.
segments.zh: 非常感谢观看这一小段视频。

segments.text: I will discuss further in my lecture.
segments.zh: 我会在讲课中进一步讨论。

segments.text: In the meantime, stay bio-safe.
segments.zh: 在此期间，请注意生物安全。

segments.text: Thank you.
segments.zh: 谢谢。
